# Fastify

> Fast and low overhead web framework, for Node.js

- [Why](https://fastify.dev/index.md)

## benchmarks

- [Benchmarks](https://fastify.dev/benchmarks.md): Leveraging our experience with Node.js performance, Fastify has been built from the ground up to be as fast as possible.

## contribute

- [Join the Fastify community](https://fastify.dev/contribute.md): Fastify is a growing and friendly community, and would be lucky to have your contributions! 🙇‍♂️ Contributions are always welcome, we only ask you to follow the Contribution Guidelines and the Code Of Conduct.

## ecosystem

- [Plugins](https://fastify.dev/ecosystem.md): - There are  core plugins and  community plugins

## organizations

- [Organizations using Fastify](https://fastify.dev/organizations.md): Fastify is proudly powering a large ecosystem of organizations and products out there.

## resources

- [Resources](https://fastify.dev/resources.md): Welcome to the Fastify resources page! Here, you can find a collection of useful resources for learning and exploring Fastify.

## search

- [Search the documentation](https://fastify.dev/search.md)
